TITLE:
After-Shower Towel Portrait

IDENTITY LOCK:
None.

STYLE:
Ultra-realistic photorealism.
Authentic handheld iPhone 16 Pro photography.
Casual Instagram-style lifestyle photo.
Natural HDR with minimal retouching.
Authentic skin texture.

SUBJECT:
Beautiful Japanese woman in her early 20s.
Long bright honey-brown hair, close to dark blonde, tied in a high ponytail with soft see-through bangs and natural golden highlights.
Large dark brown eyes.
Natural makeup.
Healthy fair skin.

BODY:
Pronounced feminine hourglass figure.
Natural feminine curves.
Graceful back line.
Soft shoulder line.
Realistic anatomy.

OUTFIT:
Large thick white bath towel.
The towel is wrapped securely around her body, but sits very low across her back.
Very deep open back, exposing both shoulders, shoulder blades, most of the upper and mid back, and the natural curve toward the lower back.
Soft plush terry-cloth texture.
Natural folds and realistic thickness.
Securely wrapped with a soft, relaxed drape.

SCENE / ENVIRONMENT:
Modern bright bathroom after a shower.
Warm beige tiles, glass shower door, clean hotel-like interior.

POSE / EXPRESSION:
Standing with her back toward the camera.
She has just noticed the camera and quickly turns to look back over one shoulder.
Wide, slightly surprised eyes.
A soft startled expression with subtly parted lips.
Direct eye contact with the camera.
Her upper body twists naturally, creating a graceful back curve and clear over-the-shoulder silhouette.
The towel sits extremely low across the back, emphasizing the large exposed back area and the natural curve of the spine.
Natural spontaneous posture with a candid, caught-off-guard feeling.

CAMERA:
Vertical 2:3 composition.
Close medium shot from slightly behind.
Natural handheld iPhone perspective.
Framing strongly prioritizes the exposed back, shoulder blades, lower back curve, and over-the-shoulder expression.

LIGHTING:
Soft warm bathroom lighting.
Natural flattering light on her face, shoulders, back, and golden-brown hair.

DETAILS:
Slightly damp-looking ponytail from the recent shower.
Soft fluffy texture of the thick white bath towel.
Fresh after-shower atmosphere.

NEGATIVE / CONSTRAINTS:
No CGI.
No illustration.
No anime.
No plastic skin.
No text or watermark.
No malformed anatomy or extra limbs.
